verdict.rationale: Dover documents an optional voluntary EEO survey at the end of applications, where recruiters see only aggregate results and never individual answers, plus a Diversity (EEO) reporting tab. That covers the compliant-demographics part of the story. Custom application questions are only implied by 'application answers' on candidate profiles, and knockout rules have no evidence at all. Missing for 10: documented recruiter-defined custom application questions, knockout/auto-disqualify rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly

citations.quote: Applicants see an optional survey at the end of the application. You only see aggregate results, never individual answers.
If you collect the voluntary EEO survey from applicants, the **Diversity (EEO)** tab shows the combined answers for all jobs or for one job, and the number of responses.
